post.description: Dual-era stateless MCP endpoint supporting modern 2026-07-28 requests and legacy initialize clients.

Agent MCP locked to one app: every aomi_chat turn runs in that app, without Auto execution, and a different application argument is a 400. An unknown app is 404 app_not_found. The OAuth resource is this exact URL on the portal origin.

post.description: Read an EVM account's native balance and nonce, optionally with recent transaction history.
Retrieve contract metadata: parsed ABI (default) or verified source, following EIP-1967 proxies to the implementation.
Discover nonzero ERC-20 holdings on one configured Alchemy Portfolio network, with exact decimal USD ranking, filters and live pagination. Excludes native currency and NFTs.
Current time and on-chain context for the connected EVM network: chain, block number, gas price, and supported chains.
Encode calldata from a function signature and simulate the contract call in one step. Simulation only — nothing is signed or broadcast.
Fetch and typed-decode any Solana account: wallet, token account, mint, PDA, or program account.
Look up a Solana program by id or fuzzy name; returns metadata and, by default, the full Anchor IDL.
List an owner's SPL token holdings, aggregated per mint, with the underlying token accounts.
Current time and cluster context for the connected Solana wallet: slot, blockhash, balance, and priority-fee signal.

schema.description: w_<public key id>; stable across account merges.

PipelineOperation.description: Callable operation descriptor with a Catalog-sourced input schema

regenerate.description: Durable completed assistant message_key in this session. Replace the conversation from the user message before it and rerun that message as a normal turn.

edit.description: User message_key to replace with message. Replace the conversation from that message and run the new text as a normal turn; mutually exclusive with regenerate.

mode.description: Execution policy. Omit for Auto unless app or applicationId selects a Direct target.

cursor.description: The caller's current event cursor. When supplied, the start page carries only events after it instead of the whole history; an expired cursor falls back to the full page rather than failing the accepted turn.

wallet.description: Switch the session's active wallet for that wallet's chain family to this account wallet before the turn runs, with the same checks as the model's use_wallet: 404 wallet_not_found for an id that is not the caller's, 409 wallet_switch_pending while the family has pending work, 422 wallet_switch_unavailable where the signer is fixed.

UserState.description: Client-owned provider, wallets, preferences, and extension values only.

wallet_pick.description: The client's current wallet pick per family. Adopted only for a family the session has no active wallet for; switching an existing session takes PUT /api/thread/wallet or use_wallet.

wallet_presence.description: Ids of the account's linked wallets that are connected on this device.

ActiveWallet.description: The session's active wallet id per family. Sent by the server; ignored as input.

broadcaster.description: Selected submitter. Auto selects hosted before assembly; an explicit wallet selection is invalid for Auto. App policy still bounds this choice.

transaction_url.description: Public explorer link for a confirmed transaction when the receipt RPC has a public origin.

oneOf.description: Historical cached-view compatibility; new views use sign plus supported_transports.

CommitApprovalView.description: Present only for an agent-wallet commit that had to wait for approval.

client.description: Connection that asked: portal, cli, oauth:<client id>, telegram:<bot id>.

expires_at.description: End of the approval window, unix seconds.

approved_by.description: portal, cli or telegram:<bot id>:<telegram user id>.

started_turn_id.description: Admitted run identity on start responses, independent of bounded history pages; retained on replay.

stopped_turn_id.description: Present only when the requested turn is durably interrupted; independent of page position.

terminal_turn.description: Actual terminal outcome of the requested interrupt, including completion or failure that won the race; independent of pagination.

runtime_sequence.description: Optional runtime ordering hint for reconciling live text; never a durable cursor

code.description: Machine-readable reason on a notice, e.g. `execution_active_timeout`

allOf.description: Earlier conversation is being summarized to fit the model's context window; the turn waits for it. A ContextCompactedEvent with the same id follows. Never sent to the model.
The summary for the compaction with this id finished. published is false when it could not be used and the turn continued without it. A working-trace step; never sent to the model.
A tool output was larger than the model's share; the model saw a shortened view (about `tokens`) and can page the full output (`bytes`) by `id`.

commitStages.description: Server-authored ordered durable Commit Service stage references. Clients must resolve all references and use Commit Service; never fall back to a direct wallet send.

maxNetworkFee.description: Maximum network cost in native base units, separate from application fees and principal.

include_tx_history.description: Also return recent transactions; the heaviest part of the call.

history_limit.description: Max transactions when include_tx_history is true (default 100).

execution.description: Present when policy routes the connected owner through an ERC-4337 executor account.

address.description: Contract address. Pass the zero address together with metadata fields to search instead.

chain_id.description: Chain ID; required alongside a concrete address.

mode.description: `abi` returns parsed signatures; `source` returns verified Solidity (heavier).

auto_resolve_proxy.description: Follow EIP-1967/OZ proxies through to the implementation's metadata.

chain_id.description: null (the default for balance questions) scans every indexed mainnet in one call. Set one chain id only when the chain is already fixed or to page that chain with cursor.

holder_address.description: Optional wallet address. Omit to use the backend-resolved execution account; pass an explicit address to inspect that address exactly.

limit.description: Page size (default 20). For top N assets, set N here and sort_by=usd_value, sort_order=desc.

cursor.description: For a selected chain only: opaque next_cursor from its previous response. Keep chain, holder, filters and sorting unchanged. Pages are live, not a snapshot.

sort_by.description: Default usd_value. Never rank different tokens by raw balance.

sort_order.description: Default desc. Unknown USD values always sort last under usd_value.

query.description: Case-insensitive discovery substring of symbol/name/address, not token identity. Named-token answers must consult query_resolution and identity; an exact contract reads that candidate. Missing or filtered holdings do not establish a zero balance.

min_usd_value.description: Minimum USD value as a decimal string. null uses 1 to hide spam dust. Once the wallet total is known, raise it to about 0.1% of that total so immaterial balances stay hidden; set it to 0 when small balances matter, such as checking gas.

include_unpriced.description: null/true keeps tokens without a price, sorted after priced ones, since any token may be real; false hides them.

hidden.description: Counts excluded by min_usd_value, missing prices or provider screening. Flagged contracts can be inspected with an exact contract query.

complete.description: True when all indexer pages were traversed; incomplete traversal returns an error. Does not imply price coverage or a stable snapshot.

registry.description: LI.FI and Uniswap reference freshness and age; separate from balance/indexer completeness.

query_resolution.description: Independent reference candidates, including contracts absent from this wallet page. Not balances. Preserve ambiguity; read exact contracts for zero/dust.

identity.description: screening (native/verified/flagged/unverified/unknown), registry_sources, provider assessments. Approval is not issuer identity; absence is not spam.

PipelineEvmContextRequest.description: No parameters; send an empty JSON object.

arguments.description: ABI arguments as strings; encode nested tuples/arrays as JSON strings.

to.description: Target contract address or ENS name.

value.description: Native value in wei for payable simulations. Defaults to 0.

from.description: Sender for the simulation. Defaults to the connected wallet's execution account; pass explicitly to dry-run as an arbitrary address.

chain_id.description: Chain override; defaults to the connected wallet's chain.

PipelineEvmEncodeCallResult.description: Human-readable simulation report: the decoded return value or a state-change preview.

decoded.description: Typed decode: user, token_account, mint, program_data, anchor, or a raw base64 fallback.

program_id.description: Base58 program id. Pass null for name search.

name.description: Fuzzy program-name search when program_id is absent.

mode.description: `idl` includes the full IDL JSON; `metadata` omits it.

idl.description: Full IDL JSON; present in `idl` mode, null when unavailable.

owner.description: Base58 owner. Defaults to the connected SVM wallet.

mint.description: Filter to one SPL mint. Mutually exclusive with program_id.

program_id.description: Token program to scan; defaults to the classic Token Program. Ignored when mint is set.

include_token_2022.description: Merge classic and Token-2022 accounts when no mint/program_id filter is set.

holdings.description: Per-mint aggregation of the raw token accounts.

PipelineSvmContextRequest.description: No parameters; send an empty JSON object. Requires a connected SVM wallet.

recent_prioritization_fee_microlamports.description: Cluster-wide mean priority fee in micro-lamports per compute unit; null when the RPC sample is empty.

next.description: Opaque continuation link for the next deterministic catalog page.

PipelineLifecycleRequest.description: Build request, explicit stage input, or a complete portable Build envelope depending on the endpoint.

transactionSafetyMode.description: EVM transaction safety selection. Initial build, stage, and Task requests use the account default when omitted. Simulation and commit inherit the sealed Build selection when omitted; an explicit override requires a fresh assessment and review.

origin.description: App, skills, and Catalog operations that assembled the actions.

expiresAt.description: Unix timestamp after which commit is rejected.

attestation.description: Server authentication of the Build owner, app scope, status, and simulation guard evidence. Older attestation versions require a new stage and simulation.

transactionSafetyMode.description: Transaction safety selection sealed into this EVM Build digest and attestation.

guardEvidence.description: Server-authored exact operation evidence carried unchanged with the sealed EVM Build.

can_approve.description: The commit awaits approval and this caller may approve it: the owner's portal session or their CLI.
